2608.30352.title: Co-Annotator: Expert-Distilled ViT and VLM for Visual and Documentation Guidance in Age-Related Macular Degeneration
2608.30352.paper_summary: Clinical AI often optimizes predictive performance without engaging how clinicians decide where to look and what to write. We present Co-Annotator, which distills expert gaze and dictation into two guidance components: a gaze-aligned Vision Transformer producing fixation-aligned areas of interest (AOIs), and an ontology-bounded vision-language model (VLM) that pre-fills editable biomarker summaries for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). We first collect expert gaze and dictations (US1) to train the models, significantly improving diagnostic accuracy and biomarker generation. We then deploy the system with ophthalmology residents: a controlled resident study (US2) confirmed each modality is safe and independently beneficial, with AOI guidance producing lasting perceptual efficiency gains through post-guidance carryover and VLM guidance more than doubling biomarker documentation breadth. In a combined deployment across two academic institutions (US3), providing both modalities simultaneously produced efficiency gains that substantially exceeded either modality alone: correct diagnoses per minute increased by 40% and comment editing time fell by 67%, without compromising diagnostic accuracy. Notably, neither modality improved efficiency during guidance in US2, which makes the in-guidance efficiency gain under combined guidance in US3 the more striking result. Expert-distilled multimodal guidance can remove two distinct clinical workflow bottlenecks at once (visual search overhead and documentation burden) without compromising the diagnostic accuracy clinicians already achieve.
2608.30352.paper_summary_zh: 臨床人工智慧通常會優化預測性能，但不涉及臨床醫師如何決定觀察何處和撰寫內容。我們提出了Co-Annotator，它將專家視線和口述提煉為兩個指導組件：一個與視線對齊的視覺Transformer，生成與注視對齊的興趣區域（AOIs），以及一個受本體約束的視覺-語言模型（VLM），為視網膜光學相干斷層掃描（OCT）預填可編輯的生物標記摘要。我們首先收集專家的視線和口述（US1）以訓練模型，顯著提高診斷準確性和生物標記生成。然後，我們與眼科住院醫師部署該系統：一項受控的住院醫師研究（US2）確認每種模式都是安全且獨立有益的，AOI指導通過後續指導的延續產生持久的感知效率提升，而VLM指導則使生物標記文檔的範圍增加了兩倍以上。在兩個學術機構的聯合部署中（US3），同時提供這兩種模式產生的效率提升大大超過單獨使用任何一種模式：每分鐘的正確診斷增加了40%，而評論編輯時間減少了67%，且未損害診斷準確性。值得注意的是，在US2的指導期間，沒有任何一種模式提高效率，這使得在US3的聯合指導下的指導內效率提升成為更引人注目的結果。專家提煉的多模態指導可以同時消除兩個不同的臨床工作流程瓶頸（視覺搜索開銷和文檔負擔），而不影響臨床醫師已經達到的診斷準確性。
